adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration copies legacy SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts lines directly into the embeddable_hosts table via raw SQL: `... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)` without any normalization or escaping. This bypasses EmbeddableHost’s `before_validation` normalization that strips `http(s)://` and paths. Later, runtime checks use `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`, which parses the referer URL and matches `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`. If the migrated DB rows contain `http://eviltrout.com` or `https://example.com/1234`, they will not equal `uri.host` (e.g., `eviltrout.com`), so embeds that previously worked can start failing authorization (`host_allowed?` returns false). Additionally, unescaped quotes/whitespace/\r in `h` can break the SQL insert or store mismatching values.
